sections.title: Words with their own forms
sections.content: Some small words have their own three forms. You know *itt* (here), *ott* (there), *otthon* (at home), *haza* (home, to) and *innen* (from here). Put them into sets: *Itt vagyok. Ide jövök. Innen megyek haza.* New words: *ide* (to here), *oda* (to there) and *onnan* (from there). Only *otthon* needs care: from home is *otthonról*, not *otthonból*.
*ide, oda* and *haza* answer *Hová?*; *innen, onnan* and *otthonról* answer *Honnan?*; *itt, ott* and *otthon* answer *Hol?*.
